_comment: Venue / local-ticketing sites whose event pages embed schema.org Event JSON-LD. Each entry: listing page(s) crawled for links matching link_pattern; every matched page's Event block imports. url_template turns a captured fragment (e.g. a Wix {"slug":...}) into the page URL. Category = mapsee frontend key. Optional "venue" {name, address, city, region, postal_code, lat, lon} FILLS a missing/partial event location for single-venue sites (every show is at the same place) - supply address+city+region and the sync geocodes it, or lat+lon to skip geocoding.
